summary: First Majestic Silver Corp. filed a Form 6-K reporting voting results from its Annual General Meeting held June 10, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine matters: election of six directors (including one with 69.87% support), appointment of Deloitte as auditor, non-binding say-on-pay (65.64% for), and ratification of long-term incentive plan awards. No special situation or extraordinary corporate event was disclosed; the filing simply reflects standard governance compliance for a foreign private issuer.
